title: Enums and Native Types
description: Define enum types and use native database types for PostgreSQL-specific columns.

data.text: Enums let you define a fixed set of values for a field. Native types let you use PostgreSQL-specific column types that Prisma does not provide a scalar for.
Enums are defined at the top level of schema.prisma and can be used as field types in models.

data.title: Enum Definition
data.content: Define an enum for user roles.

data.text: For PostgreSQL-specific types, use the `@db` attribute or raw database types. Common examples include arrays, JSONB, and custom types.

data.title: Native PostgreSQL Types
data.content: Use native PostgreSQL types like arrays and JSONB.
